identity.description: An attacker copies the LSASS process memory dump file to a writable location for offline credential extraction. Cortex should detect this behavior as a process memory file copy operation. This activity is a direct indicator of credential harvesting techniques.

expected_artifacts.description: A copy of the LSASS process memory dump file

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Copy a process memory file
biocs.description: Detection of a process memory dump file being copied to a non-system directory
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type = ENUM.FILE_COPY
| filter action_file_path contains 'lsass.dmp'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'lsass.exe'
| filter action_file_path matches 'C:\\temp\\.*'
